{{Attr|Tank}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Noob''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Pls Donate]] as part of the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. It had low health and rather slow speed for its debut. Additionally, it could also spawn with [[Bloated]] or [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attributes. ==Appearance== The '''Noob''' had a bright blue torso, green legs and bright yellow arms and head. It also had the [[w:c:Roblox:Normal face|Roblox default face]]. ==Strategy== *Early game towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Militant]] or [[Military Base]] can be useful against it. *As this enemy spawns in hordes, AOE towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Mortar]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful against them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} NoobWalk.gif|Walking animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} PLS DONATE Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Noob''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NoobFace.png|'''Noob's''' face. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Noob''' was based on [[w:c:roblox:Noob|Noobs]], as they are usually represented with a similar appearance. ==Update History== *'''13 November 2024''' - [[v1.41.0]] **'''Noob''' added. *'''4 December 2024''' - [[v1.44.0]] **'''Noob''' removed. {{PlsDonate|Start|N/A|[[Noob]]|Wave 1|[[Guest]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
